_comment: Architectural invariants for src/jazzlights, enforced on every push by
extras/site/dependency-map.py --check in the check-format CI job.
Edit this file deliberately: every change here is an architecture decision.
_comment_file_graph_is_acyclic: The file-level include graph has no cycles at all. This is the strongest invariant
here and the one most worth defending.
_comment_module_cycles: Non-trivial strongly-connected components of the module graph. There is exactly one,
and it should shrink over time, never grow.
_comment_module_dependencies: Allow-list of module -> module edges. A module is a directory under src/jazzlights/;
files directly in src/jazzlights/ form the module 'jazzlights', and src/main.cpp forms
the module 'main'. Include counts are deliberately NOT recorded here, so ordinary code
churn produces no diff and every diff that does appear is worth reading.
util MUST stay empty: it is the leaf layer.
protocol MUST stay ['util']: the wire format depends on nothing else.
